title: Tour Asset Studies
description: Five independent studies of adjacent tour-campaign assets such as ticket-page headers, lobby lightboxes, laminates, wheatpaste walls, and queue signage.
creative_direction: Independent tour assets should preserve the live-music campaign feeling through light, hierarchy, and modular date-block placeholders while avoiding readable dates, sponsor marks, or platform branding.
